title: The Stone
text: Half buried on the ridge: a standing stone, cut square, layered like strata. The drone's scan finds a joint pattern in the courses: the same interlock we use for our own foundations. Archive: "No match on file."

choices.label: Scan it again
choices.reply: Second scan, same result. The interlock is ours. The archive still says no match.

choices.label: Log it and move on
choices.reply: Logged: one carved stone, origin unknown.
